name: seis-evidence-index
description: Summarize the bounded SEIS Wave 1 evidence index and its recorded attention states without writes, network access, or release claims.

interface.shortDescription: Read a bounded public SEIS evidence summary locally.
interface.longDescription: Summarizes the checked-in Wave 1 evidence index, program progress, public marketplace counts, recorded attention states, and release boundary. It never returns raw source files, writes data, calls a provider, uses a network, or treats local evidence as publication proof.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the checked-in SEIS Wave 1 evidence index without writing files.
Keep recorded local evidence separate from live GitHub, provider, installation, or release claims.
